explanation: Living reptiles include tortoises and turtles, lizards, snakes, tuataras, and crocodilians. Birds are also included in the reptile lineage and possess characteristic features: 1) feathers, 2) a modified skeleton for flight, 3) modified respiration using lobular lungs, 4) endothermy (using metabolic heat to maintain a constant body temperature), and 5) well-developed sense organs and nervous systems. Bird diversity includes flying birds (e.g., eagles, geese, mockingbirds) and flightless birds (e.g., emu, kiwi, penguin, ostrich). Birds are normally classified by their beak type, foot type, and habitat.
